description:
Byeong-Pil, who was just discharged from the military, is conflicted about whether to return to the department he had chosen out of necessity or to find another future. At that moment, he receives a request from his senior and friend, Man-Su, to find his uncle, and with financial support from Man-Su's family, he works part-time to 'ind Man-Su's uncle with Man-Su. Since the disappearance was not related to a crime, the police drew the line that it was not their job, and since his whereabouts were completely unknown as a missing person, even the detective agency gave up, but Byeong-Pil searches for traces of his uncle through his own investigation. By entering the world of his uncle, which he had no interest in and no need to know about, and encountering his uncle's agony, joy, and ideals, Byeong-Pil's eyes are opened in a new way. Byeong-Pil meaningfully organizes his career path that he had been contemplating.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
